slug: 2025-06-18 Burundi's Land Services Go Digital with New Integrated Platform

facts.fact: We Are Tech Africa reports the land directorate DTFCN runs a Building Permit System for initial titles and a Property Management System for transfers, corrections and mortgages, joined by an EDRMS launched 17 June 2025.

systems.system: Electronic Document and Records Management System (EDRMS)
